notes.title: QOL Update
notes.content:
Fixed a handful of QOL issues.

-Adjusted hitboxes on smaller interactable objects
-Adjusted positions of interactable objects where hitbox adjustments were not viable
-Fixed a collision error with the elevator controls in the hotel lobby
-Removed auto-scrolling upon completion of the typewriter effect in the dialogue UI

notes.title: SteamDeck Hotfix #1
notes.content: We have fixed an issue with the current Linux build which would cause the SteamDeck to attempt to launch the windows build instead.

notes.title: SteamDeck Optimization Update
notes.content:
-Improved performance on SteamDeck
-Overall optimization tweaks for both SteamOS and Windows builds
-Fixed letterboxing at non-16:9 resolutions
-Fixed a number of typographical errors

notes.title: Post-MAGFest Update
notes.content: Fixed error involving missing .exe file. The error was due to a change in file structure within the game directory. Deepest apologies for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Super DRAGFest 2025 Update
notes.content:
Happy 3rd birthday to the Immaculate Drag! We're celebrating with a trip to MAGFest 2025 and a major musical update to the base game and the acclaimed original soundtrack by Evan Clarke.

Included in this update:

-Full remaster of the in-game music
-Brand new high-quality version of the soundtrack, including two previously unreleased bonus tracks
-Remixed in-game audio
-Extensive QOL updates to the game menus
-New performance optimization

If you already own the soundtrack, the new high-quality files and bonus tracks will be immediately available. If you haven't picked up the album yet, there's never been a better time.

Thank you all for three awesome years of The Immaculate drag.

And remember: breathe deep, life is short...
